facility.name: Stepping Stones Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 706 KING ST, WAKE VILLAGE, TX, 75501

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed observed the operation had air return grates and trash on the floor in several classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: It was observed that one of the five classrooms used for children was lacking a current activity plan. The activity plan posted was from 3/22.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During the review of children's records three of ten children were lacking completed admission forms. The children were missing complete address for emergency contact, school information for school age children and/or medical authorization.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: It was observed that in the restroom there was a trashcan with dirty pull ups and feces accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Medication Records - Name of Child: It was observed on  medication authorization form used.The children's last names were lacking to whom the medication was administered to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Records - Name of Child (26 TAC §746.3805(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: It was observed during inspection that the changing pad in a classroom had rips in the top and side.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Sanitize Potty-Chairs: It was observed the staff were not using sanitizing solution to sanitize potty chairs that were used during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitize Potty-Chairs (26 TAC §746.3407(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: Three of the four classrooms in use during inspection were lacking a current activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: During the walkthrough it was observed that there were broken door frams, air return grate was broken, a hole in a door in classroom, restroom with broken toilet and toilet paper on the floor.    During the inspection the toilet paper was picked up from the floor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: During the review of immunization records 4 of 10 children were lacking update immunization records.    A list of children and missing immunizations were left with operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    During the investigation it was determined that the staff in the classroom did not promptly attend to a child who was crying in their crib during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Prompt Attention to Needs (26 TAC §746.2401(4))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered that a staff while supervising children was using their cell phone for personal business while caring for a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered that a staff had not used good judgement when she placed her back to child when they were sleeping during naptime nor use self control when a parent confronted her about not wanting to take their child so they could leave the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: It was observed during the walkthrough that a child after their diaper change did not wash their hands.    This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver assisted the child with washing their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: During my walkthrough I observed a caregiver after changing a child's diaper and cleaning the changing table did not wash their hands.    This was corrected at inspection when they washed their hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: It was observed in the older infant classroom that the changing table pad had rips making the changing table pad from being non-absorbent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered: It was observed on the playground taht an wire that contacts to the air condition was accessible to children. The wire had black electric tape on the spliced wire.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - 220-Volt Electrical Connections Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(2))

occurrences.finding: Doors to Fenced Area Easily Opened By Children: During the walk through the emergency exit doors located in the both school age classroom, toddler classroom were the dead bolt was locked  and was unable to be unlocked except by a key. The pre-k classroom emergency door was dead lock was lock that did not require a key.     This was corrected at inspection when they were unlocked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Doors to Fenced Area Easily Opened By Children (26 TAC §746.5209(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed during the walk through in the older infant room  that the rubber baseboard was missing exposing sheetrock,  an octogan sitting area had rips making in unable to sanitize if soiled. In the hallway leading to school age classroom the return air vent was dirty. (photos taken)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: It was observed that a slide measuring 28" was present on the playground with no loosefill.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plans: It was obseved that the toddler classroom was lacking an activity plan posted in their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It was observed that the infant room was over ratio by three children.    This was corrected at inspection when the children were moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the Pre-K 3's classroom a power strip that was laying on a low shelf was lacking plug covers on open plugs.    The director corrected both during inspection when plug covers were placed in the power strip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One of twelve children's files reviewed was lacking phone numbers for persons listed on admission forms as person child is allowed to be release to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Two of twelve children's files reviewed were lacking a complete address/or phone number for health care professional on parent statement for health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four of twelve children's files reviewed at inspection were lacking a complete addreess for their emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Three of twelve children's files reviewed at inspection were lacking a complete address and/or phone number for Physican on their admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Three of Twelve children's files reviewed were lacking a complete school address and/or phone number.    This was corrected at inspection when the director wrote the address and/or phone number on admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §746.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: One of twelve children's files reviewed at inspection was lacking a date of admission on their admission form.    This was corrected when the director wrote the date on the admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: It was observed that the corner on the doorway leading into Pre-K classroom was missing sheetrock and the wall was peeling. There was food on the floor in the corner in the walkway of the school age classroom. There was an open package of graham crackers laying on counter in the toddler classroom and a open bottle of apple juice was on a shelf in the school age classroom.  Also, in the school age classroom there were two extension cords on the floor that could cause a tripping hazard.    (Photo taken)    The food was swept up off the floor, open food was removed from classroom and placed in garbage and extension cords were removed from the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found non-compliant.    It was discovered during interviews that a caregiver did not use good judgement when they had placed their arm around a child's neck and over their mouth preventing the child from being able to breath properly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number: Two of twelve children files reviewed during inspection were lacking a complete address for the child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Address and Phone Number (26 TAC §746.605(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: It was observed in the toddler restroom a bottle of drano was laying on the floor behind the door in the bathroom and in a classroom that is used as a pathway a wooden pumpkin wiith a wooden stake was laying on the floor. (Photos taken)      This was corrected when the director removed both the drano bottle and the pumpkin from the classroom/bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: It was observed that the operational policies was lacking a policy on physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two of twelve children's files reviewed were lacking emergency medical authorization including doctor or medical facility information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Three of twelve children files reviewed during inspection were lacking current immunizations records. A list was left with director of children and missing immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: During a review of records it was observed infant feeding instructions had not been updated since 12/2021 for 3 children in the infant classroom that are not on table food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two of twelve children's files reviewed were lacking a complete address for their emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: Two of twelve children's files reviewed were lacking proof that parent was provided with a copy of operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: It was observed during inspection that paper towels were not present in two classroom. Caregivers informed licensing that they use hand sanitizer or baby wipes to wash children and caregivers hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement: Three of twelve children's files reviewed during inspection were lacking doctor information and/or parent signature that their child had been examined wiith past year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement parent sign - Dated within past yr, name/address health care professional, states child can participate. Follow by signed statement (26 TAC §746.611(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: It was observed that the operation had not conducted a fire inspection in November after they received their initial permit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram: It was observed in several classrooms emergency and evacuation diagrams were not posted.    This was corrected when the director posted them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Emergency and evacuation relocation diagram (26 TAC §746.401(4))
